summary: Sega's 1983 vertically scrolling maze-driving game about collecting flags, changing road branches, and jumping a buggy over enemy cars.

entries.title: Up'n Down

emulation.emulator: MAME / Sega Ages: Memorial Selection Vol. 1
emulation.notes: MAME preserves the arcade version; the Saturn compilation is an official period re-release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Up'n Down began as a 1983 Sega arcade game before home-computer and console ports. The arcade version has the original presentation and sound design; the Atari 2600 port is specifically documented as changing the music because of hardware limits.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; Sega Ages: Memorial Selection Vol. 1 on Saturn is an official compilation route for the arcade-era game.
